caption:
Your lot size should not be the first decision you make.

Position sizing connects the distance to your invalidation point with the amount you can afford to risk. A larger position can magnify losses just as it can magnify gains. Understand the instrument, account currency, contract rules, and possible slippage before calculating size. If those inputs are unclear, do not guess.

Educational content only; not financial advice.
